posts.title: Simpsons Intro on crazy instruments
posts.description: Leave it to the French. Les Fo’Plafonds re-creates the Simpsons intro music using the most strange objects/instruments you can think of. Very creative – and well executed. They also do a number of other music such as the Ghostbuster’s theme, Misirlou, and many others. It reminds me of the Japanese group Electronicos Fantasticos that makes music from household electronic devices.

posts.title: AI 80’s cartoons
posts.description: Beyond What If has been giving the AI treatment to your 80’s childhood memories. Thundercats, Dungeons and Dragons, Silverhawks, Power Rangers, and more.

posts.title: Batmobile to be auctioned
posts.description: Tim Burthon’s 1992 Batmobile is going up for sale. The legendary vehicle will cross the auction block for the first time on Monday, November 23, 2026, in Los Angeles and online at Julien’s Auctions. Make sure you register to bid, or you won’t be able to win.
